perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Permeability
perks.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.

enhanced.name: Permeability
enhanced.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon. Improves handling.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector
enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Keep Away
enhanced.description: Significantly increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Deconstruct
perks.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

enhanced.name: Deconstruct
enhanced.description:
Dealing sustained damage grants bonus damage against vehicles and constructs for an improved duration and refills ammo from reserves. Damage with Primary ammo or against constructs provides additional progress.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Moving Target
enhanced.description: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.

perks.name: Loose Change
perks.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Loose Change
enhanced.description: Applying an elemental debuff to a target increases this weapon's reload speed, aim assist, and movement while aiming down sights for an improved duration.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

enhanced.name: Precision Instrument
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage significantly increases precision damage.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.
